content.title: Justin Bieber Coachella setlist: Every song he performs in order
content.text: 14 April 2026, 10:56 Justin Bieber Coachella setlist: Every song he performs in order. Picture: Getty What songs did Justin Bieber sing at Coachella? Here's a full guide to his 2026 setlist. Beliebers assemble! Justin Bieber just officially headlined Coachella for the first time but what songs made his setlist?It is wild to think that Justin Bieber has never headlined Coachella before. After first rising to fame as a teenager with his YouTube covers, Justin quickly amassed a huge fanbase and it wasn't long before he signed a record deal. He's since shaped the sound of modern pop with songs like 'Baby', 'Sorry' and his critically-acclaimed SWAG album. With so many hits to choose from, all eyes were on Justin to find out what songs he would do at Coachella this year. Scroll down to see Justin's full Coachella setlist and all the details you need to know about his live show.Read more: Sabrina Carpenter Coachella setlist: Every song she performs in order Justin Bieber performs intimate show ahead of Coachella What songs did Justin Bieber sing at Coachella?To date, Justin Bieber has released eight albums with countless hits. From 'One Time' on My World 2.0 and 'As Long As You Love Me' on Believe to 'Where Are Ü Now' on Purpose and 'Peaches' on Justice, Justin is spoiled for choice when it comes to deciding what songs to sing at Coachella this year.What songs are on the setlist though? Here's every song Justin performed on Weekend 1 of Coachella 2026:ALL I CAN TAKESPEED DEMONFIRST PLACEGO BABYBUTTERFLIESWALKING AWAYALL THE WAY405TOO LONGPETTING ZOOI DOSTAY (with The Kid LAROI)THINGS YOU DOGLORY VOICE MEMOZUMA HOUSEDOTTED LINEEVERYTHING HALLELUJAHBabyFavorite GirlThat Should Be MeBeauty and a BeatNever Say NeverConfidentAll That MattersWith You (Chris Brown cover)So Sick (Ne-Yo cover)SorryWere Are Ü NowI'm the OneYUKONDEVOTION (with Dijon)I THINK YOU'RE SPECIAL (with Tems)Essence (with Wizkid & Tems)DAISIES (with Mk.gee)Justin Bieber started his set by performing the same SWAG and SWAG II focused setlist he sang at an intimate gig at the Troubadour in West Hollywood on April 4th including an acoustic set. However, he then did an entire section of his biggest hits from 'Baby to 'Sorry' on the main stage with his old music videos playing in the background.Justin even called back to his early YouTube cover days by singing Chris Brown's 'With You' and Ne-Yo's 'So Sick' with his younger self projected behind him. Bookmark this page and we'll update it with any changes when Justin performs next week. Who are Justin Bieber's Coachella surprise guests? Picture: Getty Who are Justin Bieber's Coachella surprise guests?In the past, Justin has appeared as a surprise guest at Coachella. In 2019, Justin joined Ariana Grande on stage in her headline set. For Week 1, Justin brought out The Kid LAROI to sing 'STAY, Dijon to sing 'DEVOTION' and Tems to sing 'I THINK YOU'RE SPECIAL'. Wizkid also appeared alongside Justin and Tems to sing 'Essence'.Finally, Justin invited Mk.gee on stage to play guitar on their hit collaboration 'DAISIES'. It's currently unclear if Justin will bring out the same guests for Weekend 2 or change things up.
